newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BHP says steel review announcement imminent.
newsitem.headline: BHP says steel review announcement imminent.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (BHP) said on Monday it could not confirm that an announcement about the review of its steel operations would occur on Tuesday but said that an announcement was imminent.
Asked if the company had any deadline to release the results of the review, BHP Steel spokesman John Devers said: "No, but I can certainly say to you that it is imminent."
Devers said employees would be notified about the results of the review on the day of the announcement.
"When there is an announcement, the market will be advised first. Simultaneous to that, our employees will be advised," he Devers.
Monday's Sydney Morning Herald newspaper reported that the winding down of BHP's Newcastle works would be part of a plan to cut A$500 million in costs in the steel division over the next 18 months.
Earlier, the Australian Workers Union said it would consider launching a coordinated union campaign to block the BHP's exports if it shuts down most of its Newcastle Steel operations.
At 10.55 a.m (0055 GMT), BHP shares were seven cents weaker at A$17.39.
